faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by Tahsildar Dapoli, Revenue and Forest Department, Maharashtra for filling up Revenue Servant (Kotwal) positions.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under this recruitment?
faq.answer: There are a total of 11 vacancies available for the Revenue Servant (Kotwal) post across different categories.

faq.question: Q3. What is the mode of application for Tahsildar Dapoli Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application mode is offline. Candidates need to obtain the application form, fill it, and submit it personally or by hand at the Tahsildar Office Dapoli.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the completed application form along with required documents and fee is 17-10-2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the educational qualification required for Revenue Servant?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed a minimum of the 4th standard and possess adequate knowledge of the Marathi language.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for applying to this post?
faq.answer: The minimum age limit is 18 years and the maximum age limit is 40 years as calculated on the reference date of 02-10-2026.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application fee for Backward Class candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee for candidates belonging to the Backward Class category is Rs. 300, payable in cash at the office.

faq.question: Q8. When is the written examination scheduled to be held?
faq.answer: The written examination for the Revenue Servant (Kotwal) recruitment is scheduled to be conducted on 15-11-2026.

faq.question: Q9. What documents are required to be attached with the application?
faq.answer: Required documents include 4th standard passing marksheet, school leaving certificate, Dapoli residence certificate, domicile certificate, ID proof, caste certificate, and fee receipt.

faq.question: Q10. Where should the filled application form be sent or submitted?
faq.answer: The application form must be submitted personally or by hand during office hours at the Tahsildar Office Dapoli, Ratnagiri, Maharashtra.
